scope: All 528 fund reports, including the 169 initial no-error extractions; no selection by returns.
review_rules: Require a Chinese subsection heading after a source section number, so decimal portfolio percentages cannot become section identifiers.

Merge physical header or data fragments only at a consecutive source-page boundary with matching column geometry; preserve every original cell, page and fragment and verify each complete source row against independent text.

For three incomplete five-column header grids, use the adjacent continuation table column positions, verify the original image and retain the rejected grid. No absent data values may be reconstructed from totals.
Extend NAV source reading only to the actual financial-summary pages when the first ten pages do not contain the labelled current-period NAV. Verify current column and amount independently.

Reconcile stock/sector/asset differences against explicit source cash-substitution valuation notes. Keep the calculated residual, its sign and denominator; do not assign the residual to a stock industry or claim it is a reported cash amount.
Retain any unexplained cells, totals, denominator conflicts and source defects as failures. Full reported holdings are not actual daily look-through exposures.
